en.headline: Hoi Fan Road Park in Yau Tsim Mong opens to the public on Wednesday
en.dek: The new 16,000-square-metre park offers a seven-a-side artificial turf pitch, basketball and volleyball courts, fitness facilities, a community garden and an inclusive children’s playground, and is pet-friendly.
body: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department said the newly completed Hoi Fan Road Park in Yau Tsim Mong will open to the public from Wednesday.

Located at 18 Hoi Fan Road, the park covers about 16,000 square metres and provides a range of recreational facilities and green open space. These include a seven-a-side artificial turf football pitch, a basketball-cum-volleyball court, fitness equipment, a community garden and an inclusive children’s playground.

The park is designated as a pet-friendly shared space. Members of the public can walk there from Exit A of Olympic MTR station or Exit C of Nam Cheong station, or take buses and minibuses that serve the area.
The department invited enquiries to its Yau Tsim Mong District Leisure Services Office during office hours.

zh.headline: 油尖旺海帆道公園明日起開放 設七人足球場及共融遊樂場
zh.dek: 新落成公園佔地約1.6萬平方米，提供人造草足球場、籃球排球場、健體設施、社區園圃及共融兒童遊樂場，並開放予寵物進入。
body: 康樂及文化事務署宣布，油尖旺區新落成的海帆道公園將於周三起開放予公眾使用。
公園位於海帆道18號，佔地約1.6萬平方米，提供一系列康樂設施及綠色休憩空間，包括七人人造草足球場、籃球場暨排球場、健體設施、社區園圃及共融兒童遊樂場。
公園亦是寵物共享公園。市民可由港鐵奧運站A出口或南昌站C出口步行前往，或乘搭巴士及小巴到達。
查詢可於辦公時間致電康文署油尖旺區康樂事務辦事處。
